name: Summer Junior Volunteer Program
org: Atlantic Health System, Morristown Medical Center
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the hospital for eight weeks in summer. They work at least two four-hour shifts a week, Monday to Friday.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 17. Needs two letters of reference and proof of vaccines (MMR, Tdap, TB, flu). Do not apply if you expect three or more absences in the eight weeks.
duration: June 25 to August 13, 2027. Two 4-hour shifts a week, Monday to Friday, 9 am to 1 pm or 1 pm to 5 pm.
deadline_text: 2027 application window: opens March 1, 2027 and closes March 7, 2027. Selection is by lottery.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Here link on the Volunteer Services page. The page says it leads to the adult volunteer application. Call Volunteer Services at 973-971-5475 if you are not sure.
notes: Applications are selected by lottery. Check the exact open and close times on the page.
